requirement_text: Ranking — Your ranking for the English track is determined by the total score on the selection and a lottery. When drawing lots we work with three groups: Group 1: the 110 highest-scoring applicants; Group 2: the middle group; Group 3: the low-scoring group. For group 1 this translates to ranking numbers 1 to 110; group 2 has a better chance of higher ranking numbers than group 3. With a ranking number between 1 - 330 you are immediately placed; with a ranking number 331 or higher, you have to wait until a place becomes available when a placed applicant withdraws. After your official score has been announced, you have the option to lodge an appeal against the procedure that was followed.
scope: English-track Psychology; the general mechanism (score-plus-lottery in three bands) is likely evergreen even though the specific group-size numbers (110, 330) may vary by year with the available-places figure.
